The strict no-C/N/O-regression expectation is evaluated per element and per seed, rather than hidden by aggregate improvement.

Unsmoothed occupied-target-bin fraction counts any nonzero target bin; anchored target-bin fraction instead compares each S atom to its assigned bin. Smoothing fills more bins, so use the anchored measure for that case.
